note: Hotspot decomposition of the map workload on Windows, release builds, 7-run medians. Diagnostic variants, not benchmark twins: each variant drops a component, so the differences attribute cost, and the totals are not comparable to run.py's map.ae numbers (different program tail).
platform: Windows 10.0.26100, gcc 16.2.0 MinGW ucrt, ae release (-O2), hot cache

v2_strings.desc: + key construction: string literal + to_string per draw

hypotheses: H1: ae_to_string always heap-allocates its result (snprintf to stack, then ae_str_from_len)
H2: ae_str_cat allocates the result and memcpies both operands (1 alloc + 2 memcpy + 2 frees)
H3: every evaluation of a string literal emits ae_str_from, i.e. one heap alloc + free per literal per iteration (confirmed by reading the emitter: Expr::StrLit => ae_str_from(...))
H4: map_get + map_put hash the key twice and put copies the key (bounded by the 34.8 ms bucket)
next_single_change: Fuse literal + string concat in the emitter: ae_str_cat_lit_left/right that never allocate or free the literal operand. Removes H3's alloc+free per concat-with-literal without touching types or ownership semantics.
